title: GMUT positive self-adjoint extension, boundary-domain, and spectral-stability tribunal
hypothesis: A formal tribunal can reject a proposed linearized GMUT boundary prescription unless the operator domain, boundary form, positive self-adjoint extension, conserved-energy condition, and spectral lower-bound obligation are stated.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate operator domain, boundary pairing, extension identifier, positivity witness, energy form, spectral lower bound, local-dynamics condition, and claim class; incomplete, inequivalent, unstable, or promoted rows must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural or proxy software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the declared synthetic tribunal and does not promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
